title: Identification of a counit cone from an ordinary complementary triangle
statement:
Let $\mathcal T,\mathcal T_Z,\mathcal T_U$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Suppose exact additive functors are supplied with adjunctions $i^*:\mathcal T\rightleftarrows\mathcal T_Z:i_*$, $i_*:\mathcal T_Z\rightleftarrows\mathcal T:i^!$, $j_!:\mathcal T_U\rightleftarrows\mathcal T:j^*$ and $j^*:\mathcal T\rightleftarrows\mathcal T_U:j_*$, where in each displayed pair the left functor is left adjoint (natural Hom bijections, with units and counits satisfying the triangle identities). Suppose $i^*i_*\to1$ and $j^*j_*\to1$ are isomorphisms, $j^*i_*=0$, and for every $M\in\mathcal T$ the ordinary adjunction maps occur in a distinguished triangle $j_!j^*M\to M\to i_*i^*M\to(j_!j^*M)[1]$.

For $K\in\mathcal T$ let $e:i_*i^!K\to K$ be the exceptional counit and $u:K\to j_*j^*K$ the open unit. For any distinguished completion $i_*i^!K\xrightarrow e K\xrightarrow v C\to(i_*i^!K)[1]$, there is a unique map $\beta:C\to j_*j^*K$ satisfying $\beta v=u$, and this map is an isomorphism. Moreover $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal T}(i_*P[m],j_*Q)=0$ for every $P,Q,m$.

proof.text: Register the componentwise invertible counits as invertible natural transformations. By [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-counit-iso-right-fully-faithful], adjLeft makes iStar fully faithful. If jStar(M) is zero, jBang(jStar(M)) is zero; in the given ordinary distinguished triangle the second map adjLeft.unit.app M is therefore invertible (Mathlib Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂). Its inverse identifies M with iStar(iLeft(M)), proving the essential-image hypothesis required by the source recollement theorem.

proof.text: Apply the already proved source declaration CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Recollement.exists_distTriang_counit_unit to adjOpen, adjRight, full faithfulness, hDisjoint and the essential-image implication just proved. It supplies a distinguished triangle with precisely adjRight.counit.app K and adjOpen.unit.app K as its first two arrows. Its existing proof completes the open unit, places its fibre in the closed essential image, and identifies the fibre map with the exceptional counit through the adjunction Hom bijection and full faithfulness. Its Hom exactness uses [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact] and [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact]. Compare the given completion with this triangle by Mathlib isoTriangleOfIso₁₂, using identity isomorphisms on the first two objects. The third component beta is an isomorphism, and its second commutative square gives v ≫ beta = adjOpen.unit.app K.

proof.text: The proved source declaration Recollement.subsingleton_hom_shift gives Hom((iStar P)[m], jRight Q) subsingleton: the open adjunction identifies it with Hom(jStar((iStar P)[m]), Q), and CommShift identifies the source with (jStar(iStar P))[m], which is zero by hDisjoint. Apply this with P = iRight K, Q = jStar K and m = 1. If v ≫ beta′ = v ≫ beta, [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] factors beta′ - beta through the connecting arrow with a map from (iStar(iRight K))[1] to jRight(jStar K), which is zero. The existing source helper Triangle.cancel_mor₂_of_subsingleton implements this and proves uniqueness.
